name: PL-Universe ProWhite Robot
summary:
ProWhite is PL-Universe’s industrial embodied robot, described by the manufacturer as a humanoid platform with modular end effectors. It targets flexible operations in settings such as consumer-electronics and automotive manufacturing.

The company combines the robot with its SDPAA architecture and application services for adapting workflows, handling material and automating loading. PL-Universe reports that the original ProWhite has been mass-produced and delivered. This record represents that original platform; it is kept separate from the existing ProWhite 2.0 record.
